draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.92, the 178th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 23rd of 28 at WR. He went 132nd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (178th): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1,109 receiving yards in 2021, 10th of 28 WRs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the New England Patriots. 59 career games and 50 starts over 4 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (8 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 8 (83rd percentile), receiving td 6 (83rd percentile), team target share 18.5% (82nd percentile). Weak spots: yards after catch per reception 3.0 (16th percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 wide receiver who played: 724 receiving yards against a median of 302, above the norm.
